<title level="1" pfs="">[Stonefish](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3274)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Stonefish use their superior camouflage to lie in wait and devour small prey, becoming indistinguishable from the reefs they call home. Larger creatures are also at risk, although mostly through accidental contact with the stonefish's spines and their agonizing venom.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 14

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 12

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 9
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Stonefish.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 0">[Stonefish](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3274)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tiny" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Aquatic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=533" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 148

**Perception** +7; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +7, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +4, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +9

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +3

**Con** +2

**Int** -5

**Wis** +1

**Cha** -1
</row>

**Camouflage** The stonefish can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) in its natural environment even if it doesn't have [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372).

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +6 

**Will** +3 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 15

</row>

**Defensive Spines** When a creature moves into a space with one or more stonefish, that creature takes 1d4 piercing damage and is exposed to stonefish venom.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** swim 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bite +7 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+2 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spines +6,
**Damage** 1d4+2 piercing plus stonefish venom

**Stonefish Venom**  ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 16 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 3 hours; **Stage 1** [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61) (1 round); **Stage 2** clumsy 2 (10 minutes); **Stage 3** 3d6 poison and clumsy 2 (1 hour)

</column>
